notes: A big one — everything that's been in beta since 1.17.3. Run as many stations as you like, not just two. Playlists can mirror a Spotify or Apple Music playlist and keep themselves topped up. Listeners can tap a heart on the now-playing page, and shuffle now uses that — along with how long since a song last played and how often it's played — to keep the rotation varied instead of drawing a fresh random order every time. Right-click any song and choose "Find another version" to hear other uploads and swap out a bad rip. Updating no longer disconnects your listeners: the server keeps running while the app restarts, so they hear a few seconds of quiet instead of being dropped. Plus per-station jingles and stats, settings that apply without a restart, lower listener latency, song titles with accents reaching listeners intact, and a pile of fixes.
